points.description: Closed-loop poles: substitutes the control law to get θ̈ + 4θ̇ + 8θ = Nff r (characteristic polynomial s²+4s+8) and gives poles s = −2 ± 2j. Both poles must be correct (complex pair −2±2j).

Nff = 8, obtained from a stated DC-gain condition (e.g. set derivatives to zero: θss = b·Nff/(c+b·k1)·r = Nff/8·r, so unity gain requires Nff = 8). A bare value 8 with no DC-gain reasoning earns no mark. Consistent use of an incorrect closed-loop polynomial from P1 does not earn this mark unless the result is 8.

rubric.notes: Full marks: poles −2±2j (1) and Nff = 8 with stated DC-gain condition (1). No part-marks: each point is all or nothing. Answers with Nff = 8 but no DC-gain reasoning get 0 for P2.
rubric.answer_key: Closed loop: θ̈ + (a+bk2)θ̇ + (c+bk1)θ = b Nff r → θ̈ + 4θ̇ + 8θ = Nff r. Characteristic polynomial s²+4s+8=0 → s = −2 ± 2j. DC gain: derivatives zero → θss = Nff/8 · r; unity requires Nff = 8. Final: poles −2±2j, Nff = 8 (dimensionless).
